title: svelteesp32 RC file
description: Configuration for svelteesp32 (.svelteesp32rc.json). CLI arguments override these values.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor autocomplete and validation.

engine.description: The engine for which the include file is created.

sourcepath.description: Source dist folder with compiled web files.

outputfile.description: Generated output file. Must be a relative path (use --outputfile on the CLI for absolute paths).

etag.description: Use ETag header for cache. 'compiler' emits #ifdef arms.

gzip.description: Compress content with gzip. 'compiler' emits #ifdef arms.

created.description: Include creation time in the output file.

version.description: Version info included in the output file.

espmethod.description: Name of the generated init method (valid C++ identifier).

define.description: Prefix of generated C++ defines (valid C++ identifier).

cachetime.description: Cache-Control max-age in seconds for all files.

cachetimehtml.description: Cache-Control max-age in seconds for HTML files (overrides cachetime).

cachetimeassets.description: Cache-Control max-age in seconds for non-HTML files (overrides cachetime).

exclude.description: Glob patterns of files to exclude, e.g. ["*.map", "*.md"].

basepath.description: URL prefix for all routes, e.g. "/ui".

dryrun.description: Show route table and summary without writing output.

analyze.description: Print per-file size table and budget status without writing output; exits 1 if over budget.

spa.description: Serve index.html for unmatched routes (SPA routing).

manifest.description: Write a companion .manifest.json next to the header.
